description_short.value: Accra-based insurance and financial services group: life, non-life and health insurance, pension fund management, funeral services and property, in Ghana, The Gambia and Nigeria.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Enterprise Group PLC 2023 Annual Report (GSE PR 214/2024: report of the directors, principal activities and subsidiaries) and the summary financial statements for 2024 (GSE PR 144/2025, note 1)

description_full.value: Enterprise Group PLC is a holding company whose subsidiaries underwrite life, non-life and health insurance, manage pension funds, provide funeral services and develop and manage real estate. In Ghana they are Enterprise Life Assurance, Enterprise Insurance, Acacia Health Insurance, Enterprise Trustees (pensions), Enterprise Properties, Seventh Avenue Properties and Enterprise Funeral Services, which trades as Transitions - The Funeral People. Outside Ghana it owns Enterprise Life Assurance companies in The Gambia and Nigeria. Several subsidiaries are not wholly owned: Black Star Holdings holds the remaining shares in them. At the end of 2023 the largest shareholder was Grace Strategic Ventures, with 44.12% of the shares; the report names it as the parent company and Structured Capital Limited as the ultimate parent. The next largest holders were an SCB Mauritius Africa opportunity fund (9.94%), Cleartide Asset Holdings (7.78%) and SSNIT (4.85%). The company is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange and has its registered office at Advantage Place, Ridge West, Accra. It reports in Ghana cedis, with a financial year ending 31 December, and pays a yearly dividend.
